textbookBox.concept: Area is the number of unit squares that cover a region, so a 3 cm by 8 cm rectangle has 24 square cm and a 4 cm by 7 cm rectangle has 28.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Area is the number of unit squares that cover a region, so a 3 cm by 8 cm rectangle has 24 square cm and a 4 cm by 7 cm rectangle has 28.
beats.speakEn: Area is the number of unit squares that cover a region, so a 3 centimetres by 8 centimetres rectangle has 24 square cm and a 4 centimetres by 7 centimetres rectangle has 28.

beats.en: Perimeter is the length of the boundary, which is not a measure of area, because different shapes with the same perimeter can have very different areas.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 8 maths · Area · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: A diagonal splits a rectangle into two congruent triangles, so a triangle's area is half of the rectangle: ½ × base × height.

beats.en: A diagonal splits a rectangle into two congruent triangles, so a triangle's area is half of the rectangle: ½ × base × height.
beats.speakEn: A diagonal splits a rectangle into two congruent triangles, so a triangle's area is half of the rectangle: ½  times  base  times  height.

beats.en: Any triangle with base b and height h has area ½bh, because two copies make a parallelogram.
beats.speakEn: Any triangle with base b and height h has area ½bh, because two copies make a parallelogram.
